- Sacred Ground by Noah Bennett

- Whispers of a Forgotten Love by Lily Moon, Zoey James
- Strangers Again by Oceanic Odyssey
- When Dawn Breaks Without You by Lucas Grey
- Secrets of the Heart by Carter Knight
"""
old_songs = set()
for line in old_songs_content.strip().splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):

    if line.startswith('- '):

    # Split on " by " (case sensitive? use last occurrence)

        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]
        # Normalize: lower case for comparison
        key = (title.lower(), frozenset(a.lower() for a in artists))
        old_songs.add(key)

steps.code:
# Fetch details for all songs in all playlists and check against old_songs
# old_songs is a set of (title_lower, frozenset(artist_names_lower))
# We'll build a lookup for quick matching

# First, let's create a normalized lookup from old_songs
old_songs_lookup = {}
for title, artists_fs in old_songs:
    old_songs_lookup[title] = set(artists_fs)  # convert frozenset to set for comparison

# Now iterate through all playlists and their songs
songs_to_remove = []  # list of (playlist_id, song_id, song_title, song_artists)
for p in all_playlists:
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=p['playlist_id'], access_token=spotify_token)
    for song_entry in pl['songs']:
        song_id = song_entry['id']
        song_title = song_entry['title']
        # Get full song details to get artist names
        song_details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
        song_artists = {artist['name'].lower() for artist in song_details['artists']}
        song_title_lower = song_title.lower()
        
        # Check if this song matches any in old_songs
        if song_title_lower in old_songs_lookup:
            # Check if artists match (all old_songs artists must be in song_artists, or at least intersection)
            # The old_songs list has specific artists; we need to match if the song's artists include all of them
            old_artists = old_songs_lookup[song_title_lower]
            if old_artists.issubset(song_artists):
                songs_to_remove.append((p['playlist_id'], song_id, song_title, song_artists))
                print(f"MATCH: Playlist {p['playlist_id']} - {song_title} by {song_artists}")

print(f"\nTotal matches found: {len(songs_to_remove)}")

        song_id = song_entry['id']
        song_title = song_entry['title']
        song_details = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=song_id)
        song_artists = {artist['name'].lower() for artist in song_details['artists']}
        song_title_lower = song_title.lower()
        if song_title_lower in old_songs_lookup:
            old_artists = old_songs_lookup[song_title_lower]
            if old_artists.issubset(song_artists):
